Piramal Finance Raises Funds Through QIP and Preferential Issue

Piramal Finance has successfully raised ₹2,100 crore through a Qualified Institutional Placement (QIP). Additionally, its board has approved a preferential issue of ₹1,750 crore. The QIP funds were raised from institutional investors, while the preferential issue involves the issuance of warrants to promoters.
